objective: Improve reciprocal geometric-mean parse and transform time across frozen JavaScript, TypeScript, and React TSX corpora. SWC parser/TypeScript/React transform tests, exact transformed-AST and emitted-output semantic hashes, per-workload output size at no more than baseline plus 1%, and benchmark peak RSS at no more than baseline plus 2% are hard gates. Only the measured parser, base-transform, TypeScript-transform, and React-transform crate source trees are mutable.

meta.provenance: swc-project/swc at exact revision d5fd89520be380493479d232b88c532e94e1df94; deterministic hand-authored corpora contain no third-party source; terminal holdout received no optimizer, mutation, headroom, or seed-pilot session; only trusted correctness, feasibility, A-A/noise, and hand-authored sensitivity diagnostics were performed

upstreamTests: cargo test --locked --offline --jobs 2 --profile hone --lib --no-run -p swc_ecma_parser -p swc_ecma_transforms_base -p swc_ecma_transforms_typescript -p swc_ecma_transforms_react
evaluator executes the four frozen upstream unit-test binaries with immutable test sources and exact passed/ignored inventories: parser 177/1, base 205/1, TypeScript 4/0, React 289/45

toolchain.cargoVendor: image/vendor generated by cargo vendor --locked --versioned-dirs from pinned Cargo.lock
toolchain.buildProfile: hone: release inheritance, opt-level 3, lto=false, codegen-units=16, incremental=true, debug=0
toolchain.network: none at mutation, build, test, and evaluation time

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max; final recalibration required on frozen GCE Linux host
measurement.q: 1000000000 / geometric mean trusted-parent wall nanoseconds across three fresh-process repetitions of each primary JavaScript, TypeScript, and TSX parse+transform operation
measurement.qReferenceConstruction: qBase + max(5*sigma, 0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)) from the six interleaved baseline replicates across the two consecutive terminal ordering checks

terminalSeal.holdoutVisibility: both train and validation asset groups are holdout-only and ordering-check requires dual owner-gated terminal mode

robustnessReview.protectedPathEscape: broker freezes dedicated upstream test modules and every non-mutable path; evaluator rejects symlinks, additions, removals, and files outside the four exact crate source trees, then lexes active mixed-file test items and seals their attribute stacks, bodies, and reachability contexts
robustnessReview.testIntegrity: dedicated tests.rs files are broker-protected; active cfg(test)/test items in mixed production files are lexically extracted outside comments and strings, sealed with their contiguous attribute stacks and delimiter reachability contexts, compiled into four exact-inventory binaries, and required to exit successfully with one exact zero-failure summary
robustnessReview.benchmarkSpecialCasing: each holdout coordinate includes both corpora; the selected split supplies q while the opposite split must pass semantic, output-size, RSS, and source-hash gates
robustnessReview.fixtureFingerprinting: evaluator reads and hashes assets into root memory, overmounts the asset tree with a root-only tmpfs before compilation, then materializes source bytes without oracle metadata only after the compiled source and executable are frozen
robustnessReview.outputFabrication: candidate process returns emitted code; trusted parent counts its bytes and an immutable baseline oracle independently reparses and hashes it; AST and source hashes are compared with oracle metadata never exposed to candidate uid
robustnessReview.timerIntegrity: trusted parent times exactly one fresh-process evidenced transform per sample; measurement uid has a one-process limit and all uid-2000 processes are reaped between samples
robustnessReview.rssAccounting: trusted wait4 accounts each only permitted measurement process and enforces the per-workload baseline plus 2% ceiling
robustnessReview.buildStateIntegrity: Cargo manifests, lock, vendor tree, benchmark crate, profile, and image are digest pinned; source is rehashed after compile, source and target are kernel-remounted read-only, and the containing build tmpfs is remounted read-only before candidate code runs; only fresh bounded home/tmp mounts remain writable
robustnessReview.timedWorkBinding: every timed child performs one parse+transform and must return the source hash, transformed-AST semantic hash, and emitted code that passes the immutable output oracle
